title: struthanthus uraguensis

This hemiparasitic plant derives its nutrients from the surrounding environment, particularly from other plants. The bioactive constituents of this plant are primarily composed of alkaloids and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions of reducing inflammation and scavenging free radicals.
